warnings: No candidate was silently discarded; ambiguous frames were retained as isolated poses.
GIF previews are inspection-only and do not preserve full semi-transparent alpha.
Mirrored left-facing walk assets are generated derivatives and are marked generated_by_mirroring=true.
Three loop candidates have imperfect forward seams and use ping-pong or carry explicit review warnings.
Detached reusable props/effects were not aggressively separated where doing so could damage the composite frame.
extraction_methodology: Alpha-aware image audit using the PNG alpha channel rather than RGB background assumptions.
Connected-component analysis used only as an initial detector.
Detached hearts, notes, symbols, tears, props, and furniture were grouped by proximity, row alignment, visual meaning, and sequence continuity.
Every candidate was indexed by character, visual row, and left-to-right order.
Semantic classification was conservative; adjacency alone was not treated as proof of animation.
Only plausible temporal sequences were constructed as animations; uncertain frames were retained as isolated poses.
Character scale was estimated from body anatomy rather than full-frame bounds.
No frame was rescaled; source scale was preserved with uniform scale factor 1.0.
All runtime frames use a shared 128x128 transparent canvas and body-centered ground anchors.
Mirroring was performed only after directional audit and only where semantics were preserved.
Runtime assets are PNG frames; GIF files are previews only.
